summary: This process outlines how to add new subjects to the ERP system, including essential details like subject name, unique code, and assessment model. It also covers how to optionally restrict a subject to specific classes.
steps: (Optional) To restrict the subject to specific classes, select the desired classes in the "Define Class and Stream" option.
business_rules: The "Subject Code" is a mandatory field and must be unique for each subject. It identifies the subject, not the class.
"Scholastic" subjects are those in which marks entry is required.
If a subject is mapped to specific classes, it will only appear for mapping in those classes.
important_notes: A subject can only be edited (name, code, assessment model) if it has not yet been mapped to any class.
If a subject is already mapped to a class, only its "Display Name" can be changed, not the core subject name or code.
questions: How do I add a new subject to the system?
Is the subject code mandatory when defining a subject?
What is the difference between Scholastic and Co-Scholastic assessment models?

What happens if I try to edit a subject that is already mapped to a class?
